fact: The OU supports CaSSIS operations and hosts one of the two CaSSIS Targeting Specialists; NOMAD and CaSSIS operations run from the OU's Interplanetary Space Operations Control area at Walton Hall.

sources.t: OU SPS seminar: ExoMars TGO, the CaSSIS instrument
OU news: ExoMars TGO finds frost on tallest volcanoes

fact: The Open University was the lead institute for Beagle 2's Environmental Sensor Suite (air temperature, pressure, wind, UV, dust), designed to monitor transient events such as dust devils.

sources.t: Towner et al.: The Beagle 2 environmental sensors (ORO)

fact: JANUS was built under Italian leadership with contributions from the UK (Centre for Electronic Imaging, Open University), Spain and Germany; the OU is the UK institute on the team.

sources.t: Palumbo et al. 2025: The JANUS imager for JUICE (ORO)
